svg.text: UML component diagram. Fill colour is the component's role; connector notation is defined in the legend.
Container node · 10.99.0.12 · image m1-ada-ecu:latest — one image, two processes
holds each sampled frame to its
lateral offset from the box centre
one R3 JSONL line per detection
and the source are set here
with a monotonic stamp per entry
for both sources, pure, no I/O
explicit registration; a new plugin is
one file plus one line here
the M1 NLOS rules; registry key
the record table over the committed
the only R4 producer in the node
runs whether or not anything arrived
the ego clip — a layer, not a pin
«subsystem» Capture — the ADA→IVI wire evidence (R15, R19)
host-side readers of this node's output
run after a run, never on the data path
The detector joins the core only through the process contract: argv, exit codes, and one R3 JSONL object per stdout line. No FFI, no RPC, no shared file.
Dashed open arrow — a «use» dependency between components.
Solid triangle — realization: the component implements the interface above it.
A rounded navy frame is this node; a grey frame is a node outside it.
A dashed component is test equipment standing in for a real node.
